description: MiniMax H3 Image. Text-to-image from a prompt, or an edit when reference images are given.

prompt.description: What to generate, or how to change the reference images. Refer to references as Picture 1, Picture 2, in upload order. Up to 32000 characters.
examples: A ceramic teapot shaped like a lighthouse on a weathered wooden table, soft morning window light, shallow depth of field, product photography.
prompt.title: Prompt

images.description: Reference images for editing or composition, up to 16. JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC or HEIF; each side 128 to 8192 px; long side at most 4x the short side. Leave empty for text-to-image.
images.title: Images

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio as X:Y (e.g. 16:9, 3:4, 21:9), between 1:3 and 3:1, or auto to let the model choose from the prompt and references.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

resolution.description: Output area: 1K (about 1024x1024), 2K (about 2048x2048) or 4K (about 4096x4096). Width and height follow the aspect ratio, e.g. 2K at 16:9 is 2720x1536.
resolution.title: Resolution

size.description: Exact output size as WIDTHxHEIGHT, e.g. 2720x1536. Overrides aspect_ratio and resolution. Area 655,360 to 20,000,000 px, ratio between 1:3 and 3:1.
size.title: Size

enhance_prompt.description: Let the model expand the prompt before generating. Always on when reference images are given. When off with aspect_ratio auto, the image is 1:1.
enhance_prompt.title: Enhance Prompt

title: AppInput
